unreadableSource.result: Detailed guide timed out; no numerical specifications or implementation claims were taken from it.

provenance: This is an original HTML/CSS/JS interpretation of accessible official principles, not Huawei's native implementation. Scrub-to-preview/release-to-commit comes from the user's explicit interaction specification.

projectParameters.lightShape: 92px x 62px radial ellipse, clipped to each navigation surface
projectParameters.lightTiming: 70ms appearance, 220ms fade; no continuous animation; 0ms in reduced-motion mode
projectParameters.darkLight: Center alpha 56/255; darker candidate fill preserves text contrast
projectParameters.navigationMaterial: 10px background blur plus separate pointer-following light; phone fill alpha 133/255 in light mode, 140/255 in dark mode; no outer glow or shadow
projectParameters.phoneLayout: Floating bottom bar with 18px plus safe-area offset; content reserves navigation height plus safe area
projectParameters.breakpoints: 700px left rail; 1050px mail list/detail split; smaller widths keep a single content pane
projectParameters.touchTargets: At least 48px; phone bar items 60px tall, wide rail 68px
projectParameters.gesture: One pointerId; pointer capture; candidate attribute separate from actual page/aria-current; fresh coordinate hit test at release; nearest slot owns internal gaps
projectParameters.cancellation: Outside release, pointercancel, lost capture, blur, hidden document, resize and Escape clear preview without routing
projectParameters.compatibilityClick: 900ms suppression after gesture end, reset by a genuine new pointer down; keyboard activation is exempt
projectParameters.scrolling: Only navigation consumes pan gestures. Passive independent Touch Events keep material light tracking during native sidebar scrolling.
projectParameters.performance: No new dependencies or image downloads; light coordinates are batched with requestAnimationFrame; only the small navigation uses backdrop blur. Existing server pagination and account response guards retained.

userOverrides: Translucency and local radial light are explicitly requested, overriding generic flat-surface/gradient avoidance guidance
No automatic sweeps, full-border glow or external halo
All four destinations render real mailbox, inbox, compose or account content
verification: Isolated Edge browser regression covers trusted touch/mouse/keyboard input, two fingers, final re-hit, reversal, cancellation, compatibility click, fallback Touch Events, normal scrolling, dark/reduced motion and phone/tablet/desktop layouts. Android physical device and native keyboard acceptance still pending.
